metadata.label: after-lru
metadata.isolation: fresh child per scenario and repeat; offline synthetic data
notes: Forced GC checkpoint differences are approximate process deltas, not exact heap retained sizes.
External and arrayBuffers overlap; do not add both.
Checkpoint OS max RSS includes synchronous peaks before that checkpoint.
Heap snapshots and allocation sampling run after retained-memory checkpoints; finalMemory includes their overhead.
Inspector samples are not exact allocation counts.
Allocator fragmentation and exact temporary-allocation peak are NOT MEASURED.
